examples: Scan the QR, type your authenticator code on the phone, and you are in; from then on only the authenticator code is asked whenever the login expires.
A scan alone creates no device: a photographed QR without the authenticator code yields nothing. Five wrong codes kill that pairing and the phone says to scan again.
Revoke a mobile device and its next request is sent back to the pair page.
how_to: Open Settings > remote & security > mobile sync and switch it on (off by default; relay.enabled false kills it).
Press pair a mobile device: a QR appears (it changes every minute) with a 10 minute countdown. No camera? press no camera? show a code to get an address and an 8 character code to type.

On the mobile device, point the camera at the QR and tap the banner. The page opens Carnivore's pair page and asks for the 6 digit authenticator code. The computer shows phone scanned, waiting for its code.

Type the authenticator code. The device is paired and signed in at that moment, and the computer shows paired with the device name and a revoke button. Installing to the home screen is optional and needs no code. Tap alerts on in the app's settings to get an approval needed push.
Revoke a lost mobile device from the devices list: its connections close and its push alerts are removed. The list shows each mobile device's last seen time and last push result.

To use your own name, enter a hostname you control (for example sync.yourdomain.com) under your own domain in the mobile sync panel and add the one CNAME record it shows, pointing at your link name. Turn the orange cloud off if the record is on Cloudflare. The light turns green when the certificate is ready.
media_exempt: the pairing flow needs a real relay, a staging certificate and a second browser acting as a phone, so it is proven by a leased-slot browser script (tests/rig/test_phone_link_pair_ui.py) and cannot be regenerated by the feature capture tool
name: Mobile sync
where: Settings > remote & security > mobile sync (the switch, certificate and tunnel state, pair a mobile device, the devices list).
On the mobile device: the pair page at https://<your-link-name>/pair, opened from the QR.
Settings > remote & security > mobile sync > your own domain (name field, the CNAME to add with copy buttons, state light, remove).
